Praise the Lord, my name is Dona Saju, I am a member of St. George Forane, Chemperi in Kannur district, first of all,
a thousand thanks to Jesus and Mother Mary for giving me the opportunity to share this testimony, I am a witness to the apparition of Our Lady of Kreupasanam.
I took the Covenant for the first time on May 20th, 2025, the reason for taking the Covenant is that in my normal day-to-day life, I am a person who prays a lot.
Or I would always pray to Jesus and I would pray to the Holy Spirit.
I used to pray mostly to Father Jesus, while studying for my EC, I used to sleep hugging the statue of Father Jesus.
But I was not someone who prayed to Mother Mary like that.
It's not that I didn't like her, but I didn't have an inner devotion to Mother Mary, that's why I didn't pray to her.
Then suddenly one day I had a feeling that I should take the Covenant, and if so, I could pray the Rosary daily.
That desire suddenly came to me, I'll tell you how I came to the Covenant, but before that,
even before taking the Covenant, I started receiving many Marian presences, that is, I took the Covenant as a first pilgrim.
At that time I was studying German in Mysore, so for the first two or three days, I normally sat on my bed and prayed the Rosary.
Then suddenly on the fourth or fifth day, I felt that since I am praying the Rosary anyway,
I should light a candle, kneel down, open my hands, and pray the Rosary.
So the very next day I went to the shop and bought our normal white candles.
There is a small prayer hall in the apartment where I live, so I went there, lit the candle, and started praying.
By the time I reached the fourth mystery, I saw the candle burning brightly.
After a while, when I looked, there was a huge heart shape, and I was very happy, immediately I went out and called my friends.
They all came and took photos on their phones, and the next day I waited for evening to come.
In the evening, when I prayed the Rosary, I saw a beautiful flower appearing while praying, which was great.
The next day evening I waited inside, and when I prayed, first a flower came, and from behind another flower came.
The next day when I prayed the Rosary, there was a big flower, and in the middle of it a white Mother Mary.
If you ask which Mother Mary, it was a Mother Mary like the one at our counter number 13, and it started coming to me daily like that.
Almost my phone storage became completely full with photos.
Since my phone was full, I created a folder in Google Drive for Our Lady of Kreupasanam and started saving all the photos in it.
Later I started a page on Instagram called Divine Miracles and started saving all these photos in it.
Then there was another Marian presence, that is, on December 7th I really wanted to come here but I couldn't.
So I thought, since I couldn't, on that day I would decorate a photo of Our Lady of Kreupasanam in my room.
So by 2 o'clock I started praying the Rosary, and by 2:30 I lit a blue candle and started praying the Apparition Prayer of Our Lady of Kreupasanam.
After a while, the candle suddenly started burning brightly, so I thought maybe a flower or heart was going to come anyway.
But it wasn't like that, a statue of Mother Mary appeared on the side of the candle.
So on December 7th at 2:30 in the afternoon, Mother Mary came in the candle, and I was very happy.
Mother Mary has come to me many times, last January a big statue of Mother Mary came, that day Mother Mary even closed her eyes on the candle.
After that, a silver-grey Mother Mary has appeared in the green candle many times.
So I have received many Marian presences, similarly, there was another Marian presence while I was in Thiruvalla.
While studying German, I was sleeping hugging a statue of Mother Mary, around 5:20 in the daytime.
Someone came and gave me a single slap with a hand, I was really shocked, there was no one there to hit me.
My friend was there, she lived slightly away in the room, I am a heavy sleeper, and I get very angry if someone disturbs me in my sleep.
So I immediately closed my eyes and went back to sleep.
After a while, a hand came and held my stomach, or rather, a hand came and held me in a hugging manner.
I woke up startled, and when I looked at the time it was 5:30.
Mother Mary had called me for prayer, so at 5:30 I prayed the Apparition Prayer, and I usually go to church daily.
